seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Umberg's designation is left null because sources conflict. One summary of the general certified list reported Small Businessman/Senator. A summary of the Orange County qualified-candidate list reported Local Small Businesswoman, which appears mis-assigned. That OC summary also called Umberg the incumbent, which conflicts with a statewide guide describing District 4 as an open seat and with LAist describing him as a state senator, so incumbent is set to false; verify. Bilodeau's general designation, Councilmember/Civil Engineer, is consistent across the SoS list, the OC list and the San Diego reference ballot. A search summary of the SoS Statement of Vote summary pages gives primary shares of Bilodeau about 45.1% and Umberg about 20.7%; other primary candidates included Martin Arias (D), Cody Petterson (D) and Gardner Osborne (L). Gap: the search budget ran out before office dates, education or earlier career could be researched for either candidate.
